item: Stoplist batch 8: ten Japanese attribution tails, and the ring-map leftovers of the T5 follow-ups
key_paths: configs/stopwords_extra/ja.yml configs/stopwords_extra/PROVENANCE.md tests/test_analytics_extract.py src/static/app-insights.js tests/ring_caveat_node_test.js tests/test_stopword_batch.py
summary: Ten Japanese attribution tails (としています とコメント と強調 と指摘 と指摘した と振り返った と振り返り と振り返る と語る と説明) join ja.yml: the same kind as the kept と述べた, every one a high-confidence N with the blind repeat agreeing, none refused by the tool; the event verbs (を発表 を発売 が登場 を紹介) stay out because they say what happened. Also: a ring map whose draw failed is no longer redrawn by a language switch, the no-host guard and the loading clear are pinned, the alias refusal tests cover vi tl as and the hand-review file in their three-letter and region spellings, and the node test takes the endpoint's own method sentence.
